provider: 七嗖云盘 / 长青云盘 (7so.top, cloud.7so.top)
category: public-benefit pan on resold OneDrive, dead

free_tier.stated: 1 TB free on registration per the forum, with the sibling 银杏云盘 at 200 GB. Its own site configuration now reads '长青云盘·11月19下线' with registerEnabled false, so the offer is closed

per_object_cap.stated: Advertised as unlimited per file while the service ran

retention.stated: Shutting down: the site's own title is '长青云盘·11月19下线'. Data loss on shutdown is near-certain

egress.terms: Unmetered while it ran: '下载文件无需登录' and '不限速' were advertised, and downloads worked without an account

tooling: WebDAV on the paid tier only: '注意：上面三个网盘免费版不支持WebDAV'. The backend is described by third parties as OneDrive-based, making it a white-label reseller
chaining: Nothing to chain. One account was 1 TB with email registration and no phone, and the operator is shutting down, so the whole point was that account multiplication was trivial and each one was a single operator's resold quota

limits.value: the service is shutting down and registration is disabled
WebDAV, offline download and the rest of the useful features are paid-tier only

identity_cost.detail: an email address and no phone while registration was open. Registration is now disabled

reliability_note: A single-operator public-benefit pan running on resold OneDrive, which is the classic will-die-without-notice class.

evidence.proved: {"title":"长青云盘·11月19下线","registerEnabled":false,"emailActive":true}, so the site says it is closing and has closed registration
'1TB免费空间 / 下载文件无需登录 / 支持WebDAV / 不限速', with the caveat '上面三个网盘免费版不支持WebDAV'
'七嗖云盘/银杏云盘是由鄢杰与荣6呀运营的公益云盘，注册后将有1TB大容量存储（银杏云盘有200GB）'
HTTP 200 with 7,120 bytes in 2026-10, so the landing page still answers while registration is closed

binding_note: The service is shutting down on a date its own configuration states and registration is already disabled, so the retention clamp is the whole finding.
notes: Recorded because the corpus's rule is that a provider which dies becomes a dead record with the evidence, and because the trajectory, 1 TB free to a shutdown notice, is what the whole public-benefit pan class looks like.
